reviews.title: I have had a fantastic experience with…
reviews.body:
I have had a fantastic experience with Lebara. Their network reliability and value for money are great, but what truly sets them apart is their top-notch customer service.
A special shoutout to Faizan, who was exceptionally helpful, polite, and patient. He went above and beyond to answer my questions and resolve my query quickly without any hassle. It's rare to find such dedicated support these days. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Money for nothing
reviews.body: I have contracts running for phones not used. I constantly ask for help and you do not respond helpfully. I only have an email from previous complaint. My bank shows 2 x £5 payments one week then £5 and £9 next week. For 2 yrs my Granddaughter had no phone, text or data use leaving her unsafe after school. She can only use home WiFi. I am a foster carer and told the organisation lebara is unsafe to use for the children. I want refund of her contract and information why you are constantly charging me for many payments. I should have only 1 x £9 contract and 1 x£5 mine running. I am going to Ombudsman and review sites. I was going to upgrade my data but you are also more expensive than others for higher data. My Granddaughter is very upset. You also said youd cancel her contract as she had not used it!!! We wrote She Cannot as you wont allow it to be used. NO help as always

Varsha Prajapati said that as an exception,  5GB bundle will be given. Good service! Our whole family is with Lebara so it was great to see the reward for our loyalty.

reviews.title: Charging Issue
reviews.body: Have been trying to get Lebara customer services to resolve an issue with my online account for months. I have three mobile numbers / SIMs with Lebara. For one of them my online account is showing I am being charged £2.34 but I am actually being charged £4.90 to my bank account. I keep ringing customer services and emailing them but they can't resolve it. Every time I ring they question me whether what I am saying is right, I send a screenshot of my account as evidence  and hear nothing more.

reviews.title: Bilal gave me a wonderful customer support experience.
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful experience speaking with Bilal. His calm, reassuring manner and respectful approach genuinely put me at ease and made me feel confident that I was in good hands.
I have been happy with Lebara’s services so far, and speaking with Bilal has further strengthened my confidence in the customer support team. He has been one of my first points of contact with Lebara, and I believe the way a customer is treated can make all the difference in shaping their impression of a company. Bilal has certainly made a very positive one.
Thank you, Bilal, for being so helpful and reassuring!
